related_questions.question: How much does a COVID shot cost without insurance?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine is no longer free for most people without insurance. If you don't have health coverage and don't use discounts, you can expect to pay $200 or more for a COVID vaccine. And an administration fee may be added to the cost of your shot. You may be able to save on your COVID vaccine with a GoodRx coupon.

related_questions.question: Is it safe to get vaccines at pharmacies?
related_questions.snippet: Pharmacies have the same vaccines that doctor's offices have. They only vaccinate children for necessary shots according to the CDC immunization schedules. Q: Are vaccine side effects the same in children as adults? A: Generally, yes.
